source.authoredBasis: Deliberate false right panel uses |k|/x for negative k; the left panel is correct. Panels are centered at (-4,0) and (4,0); local axes have identical unit scale and a [-3,3] square window. Reciprocal curves use separate log-spaced segment branches and no x=0 point. Line candidates pass through the local origin. k=±1 represent shapes, not the same quantitative curve for every nonzero k.

authoritativeText.text: 122. 作出函数 $y=\frac{k}{x}$ 的草图（分 $k>0$ 和 $k<0$ 两种情况）。

inventory.description: Authored k > 0 panel, 6 by 6 unit grid, local axes, visible opposite markers and segments. Hidden nodes are covered through the mapped assertions. Each opposite defining point pair is asserted; the header is a condition, not a claim that the candidate is true.
